scope.why_not_all_neos: JPL CNEOS already computes close approaches for the entire NEO catalog (43391 objects in this refresh). Re-integrating all of them with N-body every day would not change the public list and would be a poor use of a low-priority Pi 5. We instead re-integrate every upcoming Earth approach within 0.01 au, the 200 closest, and every condition-code-0 upcoming Earth approach — the encounters visitors will look at first, plus the best-constrained orbits.
